info.name: X2Mail
info.summary: Webmail for Nextcloud that signs in to your mailbox with the SSO token, without a mail password
info.description:
X2Mail is webmail for Nextcloud with native SSO.
Log in to Nextcloud through your OIDC provider and open Email. X2Mail passes your OIDC token to the mail server via OAuth2 (OAUTHBEARER/XOAUTH2), so users never enter a separate mail password or see a second login form.
X2Mail uses Nextcloud's own APIs. It needs no external services and no database of its own.
### Nextcloud integration - Contacts: read, create and edit contacts in all your Nextcloud address books - Files: attach files from Nextcloud Files, save emails and attachments there - Calendar: add ICS invitations to your calendar, with a warning if the event already exists - Dashboard: widget for unread mail, with automatic OIDC token refresh - Search: find emails through Nextcloud Unified Search - SSO: IMAP access with your OIDC login instead of stored credentials
### Features - SSO without extra configuration in X2Mail: OAUTHBEARER and XOAUTH2 are detected automatically and the token is refreshed before it expires - Nextcloud admins manage X2Mail in the Nextcloud settings, without a separate admin password - Setup wizard with preflight checks for IMAP, SMTP and OIDC, plus token diagnostics - Nextcloud theme with light and dark mode - Server-side mail filters (Sieve) - Multiple sender identities - OpenPGP and S/MIME - Command line: `occ x2mail:setup`, `occ x2mail:status`
### Setup ``` occ x2mail:setup --imap-host mail.example.com --domain example.com --sieve ```
### Requirements - Nextcloud 33 to 35, PHP 8.3+ - Mail server with OAuth2 SASL (OAUTHBEARER) on IMAP and SMTP submission; tested with Dovecot 2.4+ with Postfix, and with Stalwart 0.16+ - `user_oidc` with an OIDC provider; tested with Keycloak
